Subject: Question: portal enrollment vs continuing email batches

Hi Mina,

Quick question as we prepare to onboard: we currently send weekly bundled PDF invoices that include multiple POs per file (often 3–6 POs). Does Redwood require each PO as a separate invoice in the portal, or can we continue sending a single PDF with the PO numbers listed on separate lines?

Also: if we stay on email for now, what subject/token conventions do you need so our invoices are processed automatically (we want to avoid manual routing)?

Can you share your onboarding form and a sample CSV or preferred layout?

Thanks — Priya

Subject: Re: Question: portal enrollment vs continuing email batches

Hi Priya — thanks for the note. Attaching our onboarding form and a sample CSV to this thread (see Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf and Sample_Invoice.csv). Short answers up front:

- Portal is preferred for accuracy and faster ACKs (we provide an upload UI and API).
- If you must email, use a single invoice per email whenever possible. We can accept a PDF with multiple PO line items but that increases manual review and holds up automated PO stamping.
- For multi-PO situations we strongly prefer either: 1) portal CSV with one row per PO/invoice line, or 2) an emailed CSV attached (not a flat PDF).

Subject token for email fallback: please include this exact token in the subject line: REDWOOD:INV:ORCHID:{vendor-account-id} (example: REDWOOD:INV:ORCHID:ORCH-3245). That lets our ingestion pipeline route automatically.

PO handling: if multiple POs are billed on one legal invoice, include a table in the CSV with PO, line_amount, tax, currency, and invoice_line_reference. If you can't produce CSVs yet, send a single PDF per PO as a short-term workaround.

SLA/acknowledgement: portal uploads get near-real-time acknowledgements (T+ minutes). Email attachments are batched into our parser (T+48h typical) unless the subject token is used and the CSV schema is followed.

Next steps: fill the onboarding form and follow the portal link (I included the form fields and a Drive link). If you'd like, Vanessa can schedule a short onboarding session to walk through CSV export from your ERP.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Vendor Ops | Procurement
Redwood Inference

Thanks Mina — couple of follow-ups:

- Tax/VAT: some of our lines have VAT included and some don't. Does your CSV support per-line tax fields or do you need total tax only?
- Consolidation: our billing team historically consolidates multiple POs into one PDF invoice and references the PO numbers in the body (e.g., PO: 1001, 1003, 1007). Is that acceptable if we include a summary table in the PDF?
- Subject token: can the token be placed in the email body instead of subject? Our ERP is limited on subject line customization.

If you prefer, we can export a zipped CSV with multiple invoice rows — would that be acceptable?

— Priya

Hi Priya — Markus from Finance here. Quick clarifications from the ledger/payment side:

- Tax handling: we support per-line tax fields (tax_amount, tax_rate) in the CSV; please include currency per line if you invoice in multi-currency.
- Consolidated PDFs: finance prefers a one-invoice-per-PO model for automatic PO matching. If you must consolidate, include a machine-readable CSV attachment (or CSV embedded in a ZIP) that enumerates each PO and the corresponding line amounts — that allows automatic routing and avoids manual intervention.

Mapping guidance (high level):
- invoice_number, invoice_date (ISO), po_number, line_description, quantity, unit_price, line_amount, tax_amount, currency, remit_to_entity

If you send a consolidated PDF without a companion CSV, expect manual review and longer payment timelines.

Markus Klein
Senior Accounting Manager, Redwood Inference

Hi Priya — summarizing next steps so we have an action plan: 

1) Please complete Onboarding_Form_v3.pdf and upload via this portal link: https://app.redwood.com/enroll/portal-onboarding?acct=orchid
2) If you can export CSVs from your ERP, use the Sample_Invoice.csv schema we attached. If not, send a zipped CSV with one row per PO and one invoice_number per legal invoice.
3) Use subject token REDWOOD:INV:ORCHID:ORCH-3245 for email fallback; placing the token in the subject is required for automatic parsing. If your ERP can't, we can allow an exception but it will be manual.
4) Vanessa will schedule a 30-minute onboarding session (CSV export + portal demo) once we receive the completed form.

Expected ack windows: portal upload = T+15–30m, CSV email with token = T+6–24h, PDF-only consolidated = T+48–72h (manual).

DocuSign: I've added the portal enrollment doc to DocuSign; link is in the Drive folder. Once signed we can enable your vendor account and provide API keys (if requested).

Let me know if you'd like me to walk through a sample export — Vanessa can join.

Best,
